patronOf.en-US: The priest greets the gathered people
patronOf.pt-BR: O sacerdote saúda o povo reunido

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o amor do Pai e a comunhão do Espírito Santo estejam convosco.

meta.basis: After the Sign of the Cross, all standing, the priest at the chair, 'facing the people and extending his hands', greets them (GIRM 124; the Order of Mass: 'abrindo os braços, saúda o povo'). The chair faces the people at the head of the sanctuary (GIRM 310), so the card looks over the priest's shoulder at the assembly the Greeting makes manifest (GIRM 50).
